proposal_AC.title: The planner may pick a module or namespace as an API Reference hub, and the renderer heads it with its bare final path segment over an empty member list - so 'Detailed Member Reference' renders three headings and three blurbs and no members at all.
proposal_AC.file: src/repository_presenter/components/readme/composition/planning.py (which symbols are admitted into api_hubs) with the rendered consequence in renderer.py::_api_reference and api_reference_names.
proposal_AC.repository_and_evidence: aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Java, this run's own sealed bundle, README.md lines 394-408.

measured_zero_provider_calls.the_hubs: plan.json's api_hubs are public_symbol:org, public_symbol:org.aspose and public_symbol:org.aspose.cells_foss - all three symbol_kind 'module' (Java packages), none of them a type.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_headings: api_reference_names gives a non-class symbol 'its final segment', so the renderer emits '### org', '### aspose' and '### cells_foss' - three bare path segments of one package, read by a human as three unrelated words. '### cells_foss' is the split-identifier shape loop-prompt.md section 6 rule 8 names.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_emptiness: api_reference_hub_methods returns 0 owned members for each of the three, so '#### Detailed Member Reference' is followed by heading + one-sentence blurb + heading + blurb + heading + blurb and nothing else - mechanically generated filler, which rule 8 also names.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_level_inversion: the group heading is '#### Detailed Member Reference' and each hub under it is '### <name>' - the children are a level shallower than their own parent.
measured_zero_provider_calls.it_is_a_class: Replayed over every bundle directory on disk (11, including one older revision): 86 planned api_hubs, 33 of them non-type symbols and 35 of them rendering ZERO members, in 9 of the 11 directories. Whole-group cases: Cells-Java 3 of 3 empty, 3D-Java 1 of 1 (com.aspose.threed), PDF-Java 1 of 1 (org.aspose.pdf) - in all three the entire Detailed Member Reference is empty. Partial: Cells-Go 8 of 12, 3D-Python 7 of 10, Email-Python 4 of 12, Slides-Python 3 of 12, Cells-Cpp 2 of 5. Clean: Cells-.NET 0 of 12, Cells-Rust 0 of 12.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_contract_is_explicit: README_CONTRACT.md row 14 says '#### Detailed Member Reference with ### <Topic> groups listing the HUB TYPES' verified members as nested bullets', and its section on presentation_planning says 'which TYPES are the entry-point hubs the API Reference intro and Detailed Member Reference lead with'. A module is not a type and owns no members, so today's plans are outside the contract's own wording, not merely inelegant.

proposal_AC.fix: Admit into api_hubs only symbols whose symbol_kind is a type for the ecosystem (class, enum, struct, interface, trait) or - for ecosystems with no types, e.g. Go - a symbol that api_reference_hub_methods gives at least one member, and drop a hub that renders no members before the group is emitted so the group never prints a heading with nothing under it. The heading level inversion is the separate, smaller half: the hub headings belong a level below their group heading.
proposal_AC.alternative_rejected: Leaving the planner free and filtering only at render time. That hides the selection defect: the plan would still record hubs the document does not show, and the plan is the artifact the review and the coverage ledger read.
proposal_AC.second_alternative_rejected: Rendering a module hub's contained types as its 'members'. That duplicates the Core API table, which already covers every verified type exactly once (row 14), and grows the collapsed block without adding a verified fact.
proposal_AC.mutation_test: A plan whose api_hubs name a module symbol with no owned members must not render a Detailed Member Reference group for it; a plan whose hubs are types with members must render exactly today's bytes (Cells-.NET and Cells-Rust, 0 of 12 empty each, are the live controls).
proposal_AC.cost_if_landed: Rendered bytes move for the 9 affected bundle directories, so it is a RENDERER_VERSION bump and a re-seal question for the grandfathered bundles - the same shape as arrival item 65's own ruling (2026-09-11 21:52 +05:00).
